knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The pass pattern covers the full mat depth; a single pass leaves soil in the matting.
Lift doors can move, so work must not start until the lock-out is in place and confirmed.
Motors, controls, door mechanisms and electrical parts are outside a cleaner's scope and belong to the lift contractor.

practicalCriteria: Vacuums a sample mat with the full pass pattern and clears soil from beneath it.
Confirms the lift lock-out with the building contact before starting, and records it.
Cleans a sample track with the correct tool and product and leaves the mechanism untouched.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80 per cent pass mark, so all three must be correct. The practical sign-off is separate, observed by an assessor, and is not shown by a quiz result.
evidenceRequired: Observed practical sign-off on assessor sheet
Lock-out record with the building contact's name and time
stopWorkCriteria: Work started near lift doors without a confirmed lock-out
Spray applied into the door mechanism or electrical parts
Attempted work on lift motors, controls or doors
